title: papaver alpinum subvar. aurantiacum
intro: Papaver alpinum subvar. aurantiacum, commonly known as the Alpine Poppy, is a subvariety of the Alpine Poppy plant (Papaver alpinum) that is characterized by its bright orange flowers. The Alpine Poppy is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The plant's therapeutic actions include sedation and a calming effect, making it a possible remedy for insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of Papaver alpinum subvar. aurantiacum include alkaloids, such as papaverine, which have been reported to possess analgesic and vasodilatory properties.
